newsitem.title: USA: World Bank inspection panel to review Yacyreta dam.
newsitem.headline: World Bank inspection panel to review Yacyreta dam.

text.p: The World Bank said Friday that it has asked its independent inspection panel to review its plan for tackling environmental and other problems arising from the Yacyreta dam between Argentina and Paraguay.

The move is in response to charges by a non-governmental organization in Paraguay that an ongoing expansion of the dam has had adverse effects on the environment and on people living in the region who have had to be resettled.

The Bank is in the process of working out an "action plan" with Argentina and Paraguay to counter the problems posed by the expansion, which aims to raise the dam's level to 274 feet (83 meters) above sea level from 251 feet (76 meters).
It gave the inspection panel four months to review the plan and report back to the Bank's board.
The Bank has lent the hydroelectric project on the Parana River more than three-quarters of a billion dollars over the last 15 years.
